name: Secrecy or low-transparency jurisdiction nexus
description: Entities, accounts or assets are booked in jurisdictions offering strong secrecy or limited transparency, including where unrelated to the entity's operations.
fp: Legitimate holding structures and funds use such jurisdictions for tax neutrality or legal reasons.
